content:
Anomaly detection has the following prerequisites:
• Anomaly detection requires OpenSearch or Elasticsearch 7.4 or later.
• Anomaly detection only supports ﬁne-grained access control on Elasticsearch versions 7.9 and
later and all versions of OpenSearch. Prior to Elasticsearch 7.9, only admin users can create, view,
and manage detectors.
• If your domain uses ﬁne-grained access control, non-admin users must be mapped to the
anomaly_read_access role in OpenSearch Dashboards in order to view detectors, or
anomaly_full_access in order to create and manage detectors.

hierarchy.parent: Anomaly detection in Amazon OpenSearch Service
